groupTitle: adidas Samba Jane Satin - Girls' Grade School

model.name: adidas Samba Jane Satin - Girls' Grade School
model.description:
Legacy meets a fresh feminine twist with the adidas Samba Jane. Taking the iconic silhouette of the Samba OG and reimagining it as a ballet flat, these sneakers bring a playful vibe to every step. Crafted with a smooth satin textile upper and a secure hook-and-loop strap, these kicks offer a snug fit and durable traction for all-day fun.

  • Satin textile upper provides a smooth feel and durable finish
  • Hook-and-loop strap closure ensures a secure and adjustable fit
  • Textile lining offers comfortable support for active feet
  • Rubber outsole delivers reliable traction on street surfaces
  • Signature stripe detailing and logo callouts add classic style

Material & Care
  • Satin upper
  • Rubber outsole
